description: The individual takes X-ray skiagraph (Photographs) for diagnosis of ailments or gives ray treatment by operating X-ray equipment and exposing patients to the rays. Prepares or gets patients prepared by Nurse for ray exposure. Regulates duration and intensity of exposure by adjusting machines and exposing patients to rays as directed by the Radiologist. They are responsible for preparing patients and operating equipment for the test, besides keeping patient records and adjusting and maintaining equipmentetc.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Demonstrate Electromagnetic radiation, production of x-ray, construction of modern x-ray tube, and Interactions of x-ray with matter.
Identify the X-ray circuit and units, radiographic grid and beam restricting devices and operate the console panel.
Perform radiation protection and operate radiation measuring devices and understand Radiology.
Assemble General and radiographic anatomy, bones, joints and body systems using mannequins and skeletons.
Execute the radiographic and darkroom techniques, perform the radiographic film processing and check radiographic image quality.
Demonstrate understanding of contrast media and perform radiographic positioning of body systems.
Perform advanced radiographic special procedures and understand systemic anatomy and physiology.
Analyze CR, DR, OPG, and fluoroscopy systems, adjusting exposure and processing to achieve desired image quality.
Interpret the factors, tools and techniques affecting the radiographic image quality.
Perform basic CT scan positioning and imaging procedures safely.
Perform advanced CT procedures and assist in special imaging techniques.
Operate MRI scan and perform patient positioning, review protocols for MRI scanning.
Analyze USG and mammography scans patient positioning, preparation, techniques, general care.
Illustrate patient care and preparation for CT, MRI, DEXA, mammography, USG, oral radiography, and emergency trolley use.
Select and plan the radiographic calibration and Tube rating charts.
Analyze medical emergency conditions and demonstrate their remedies.
Interpret basic radiotherapy procedures, radiation biology, and radiation effects.
Perform basic dosimetry, radiation safety, and radiotherapy treatment planning procedures.
Perform nuclear medicine procedures and ensure patient safety and quality control.
Employability Skills 180 Hours
On the Job Training (300 Hours for 2 year trades)
